items.name: HomeX
items.description: HomeX is an ESP32-based smart home automation system supporting manual control, rule-based (if–else) logic, and neural network–driven automation. It begins with synthetic sensor data for initial training and later collects real-time data via Google Sheets (JavaScript API) to enable continuous model retraining and smarter control

items.name: OpenVCT
items.description: OpenVCT is an open-source toolkit for Virtual Clinical Trials in medical imaging. It allows users to simulate breast images, insert synthetic lesions, run preprocessing and denoising methods, and build reproducible research pipelines. Ideal for testing imaging algorithms in controlled conditions.

items.name: bsynth
items.description: :exclamation: This is a read-only mirror of the CRAN R package repository.  bsynth — Bayesian Synthetic Control. Homepage: https://github.com/google/bsynth, https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.01779  Report bugs for this package: https://github.com/google/bsynth/issues

items.name: RLDatasetCreator
items.description: This repo contains a synthetic dataset generator that creates optimal trajectories with controlled noise for training decision transformer models in offline reinforcement learning. It is written in C++. It features environment simulation, discounted reward calculation, and strategic noise injection to enhance model generalization and performance.

items.name: Washing_Machine
items.description: Development journal for an embedded washing machine control system. Covers on/off logic with audio feedback, potentiometer-based temperature (40/50/60°C) and cycle selection (Cottons, Synthetics, Delicates, Quick Wash), door-safety detection via LDR, a seven-segment countdown timer, emergency stop, and a serial status interface.

items.name: Vocalise
items.description: Vocalise is a real-time voice transformation engine that lets you reshape your voice instantly using AI. Built for low-latency communication, it applies advanced voice conversion models to turn your microphone input into natural, expressive synthetic voices. Whether you're using it for, Vocalise gives you full control over how you sound.
